attacks.name: Symbiote Spider Technique
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If this character has already attacked the defender during its Activation this Turn, this character may reroll any number of its attack dice for this attack.
If this character has Advanced or been Placed during its Activation this Turn, after this attack is resolved, it may Advance |!movement_large|.

attacks.name: Maximum Gwenom
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each |!damage| dealt.
|!wild|, |!hit| |*Rampage|: After this attack is resolved, deal 1 |!damage| to each other enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character.

superPowers.name: Dark Rage
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character of Size 3 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Pick on Someone Your Own Size
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting another allied character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may make an attack against it. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to two of its defense or dodge dice.
